capabilities: Generate structured Q&A, concept pages, and question graphs from questions and selections
Plan reading projects and writing projects with outlines, chapters, and character cards
Draft, continue, insert, polish, and expand prose
Sync vaults through Baidu Pan or Git and publish articles via Wechatsync
disambiguation: Not just a note generator; it is a broad knowledge, writing, annotation, and sync workspace.
extras: UI labels are Chinese; AI features send selections and partial note context to the configured endpoint. Sync is disabled by default.
problem: Scattered notes, reading material, and writing drafts live apart, with no single place to turn questions into linked notes or carry a project from outline to prose.

relations.evidence: The model dropdown offers deepseek-flash (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, recommended)
Baidu Pan storage — configure your application, authorization, and remote path; currently the supported storage service.
send image articles to WeChat Official Accounts, Zhihu and Bilibili column drafts through Wechatsync

summary: AI workspace that turns questions and selections into linked concept notes and also plans reading and writing projects, annotates, proofreads, and syncs vaults.
